source: deterministic synthetic hourly candles only; no market download, holdout or fit
polars: not required for this scan workload; no unregistered engine search
cache: OS cache not cleared; separate fresh process first-use from later filesystem-warm runs; hashing included
result: all canonical primitive rows in original manifest order plus exact per-horizon eligible/excluded/common-pair digests; complete result consumption and verification included
numeric_tolerance: exact decimal strings and integer ns; no approximate comparison
uncertainty: paired ratio bootstrap across 7 independent process runs, 10000 resamples, seed 6505, 95 percent interval; exploratory descriptive evidence on one host, not universal statistical guarantee
disqualify: any semantic mismatch, effective-control failure, quota/cancel/cleanup failure, unsupported candidate startup; retain failures and do not silently change configuration
decision: minimum sufficient qualified path or unchanged PyArrow; no Rust, capacity, predictive-skill, automatic promotion or old-path deprecation claim
